## Feature Summary
A concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

## Problem Statement / Civic Need
What problem does this feature solve? How does it benefit citizens, researchers, or government administrators?
*(e.g., "Citizens from regional farming communities struggle with...")*

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you envision this working within the existing architecture (React frontend, AST eligibility engine, or Supabase backend).

## Alternative Approaches Considered
Any alternative designs or workarounds you have considered.

## Alignment with Core Trust Model
- [ ] Confirms to the core principle: **AI assists, verified rules decide** (No delegation of eligibility decisions to generative LLMs).
- [ ] Preserves deterministic auditability and fail-closed security.
